tasks.title: Announcement #9
tasks.instruction: Listen to a principal talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript: I was not impressed with your behavior during today's talent show. Those were your friends and classmates who were performing on stage. It was very rude of you to talk loudly and send text messages throughout the performance. An audience should not act that way. I'm very disappointed in you.

questions.stem: What is principal’s attitude towards students’ behavior in talent show.

options.A: The principal feels happy because students show great interest in the show.
options.B: The principal is angry at some people’s absence.
options.C: The principal criticizes students’ disrespectful deeds in the show.
options.D: The principal think students’ applause is not loud enough.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问校长对学生才艺展示上行为的态度，属于态度/观点理解题，需抓住校长讲话中的情感色彩和评价性语言。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 校长明确表示“I was not impressed”、“very rude”、“I'm very disappointed”，说明他感到不满而非高兴。 选项B：错误。 校长批评的是学生在表演过程中的不当行为（大声说话、发短信），而非有人缺席。 选项C：正确。 校长指出学生大声说话、发短信是“very rude”（非常无礼），并表示失望，说明他批评了学生不尊重的行为。 选项D：错误。 校长没有提到掌声不够响亮，批评的是干扰表演的行为，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: Why does the principal talk about sending text messages during a performance?

options.A: To give an example of bad behavior
options.B: To explain why the students were loud
options.C: To show that he received the messages
options.D: To prove that cell phones are a problem

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问校长为什么提到在表演期间发短信，属于推理判断题，需理解这一具体行为在讲话中的作用。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 校长列举了学生的不当行为（大声说话、发短信），发短信是作为不尊重观众行为的一个具体例子。 选项B：错误。 校长并未解释学生为什么大声说话，而是指出这些行为本身是不对的。 选项C：错误。 校长没有表示自己收到了短信，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 校长批评的是在表演期间使用手机发短信这一行为本身，而非笼统地讨论手机是个问题。
